messages.author: Unknown Identity
messages.text: I tried buying a new province, but it keeps running into an unexpected error, no explanation. I have enough cash

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@519965006867988490> found it: when every tile around your provinces was already taken by other nations, the game tried to put the new province on a tile that's already occupied and crashed. it now looks further out for the nearest free tile. fixed, should be live within the hour

messages.author: Kurai
messages.text: Still not working for me, did we already occupy the whole server <:teacat:1521721302946287769>

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@519965006867988490> <@519965006867988490> <@1002628734932762755> the province fix is live now. i checked it against the real game: 136 nations are boxed in by their neighbours (the exact case that crashed), and buying a province now works for the ones i tried, including yours - it finds the nearest free tile further out instead of failing. if it still errors after a refresh, tell me your nation name and i'll look at it directly

messages.text: since when is there a cool and epic world map of provinces!?!?
